findings.body: The comment says cache reads are a hundredth of the input price, which for `input: 0.435` would be `0.00435`. The actual value is `0.003625`, which is `0.435 / 120` and about 17% lower than a hundredth. This either misdocuments the verified ratio or underreports cached-token cost. Update the value to `0.00435` or correct the comment and re-verify against OpenRouter.
findings.title: Correct the cached-price comment or value for deepseek-v4-pro

value.summary: The change adds new model price rows and tests that the default-selected models are priced, including checks for cached/output billing order. The code looks mostly sound, but one cached-price comment/value mismatch should be corrected before merging.
